winter-walker.summary: A hunter of the frozen north, like Icewind Dale, who wears rime as armour and turns the cold on its quarry.

Frigid Explorer.summary: Resist Cold; Cold you deal with weapon attacks, Ranger spells or Ranger features ignores Cold Resistance. Once per turn a weapon hit can add 1d4 Cold (1d6 from Ranger 11).

options.name: Biting Cold
options.summary: Cold you deal with weapon attacks, Ranger spells or Ranger features ignores Resistance.

options.name: Polar Strikes
options.summary: Once per turn, a weapon attack hit can deal an extra 1d4 Cold; 1d6 at Ranger 11.

Hunter’s Rime.summary: Casting Hunter's Mark grants 1d10 + Ranger level Temporary HP, and a creature you've marked can't take the Disengage action.

Winter Walker Spells.summary: Always prepared: Ice Knife at Ranger 3, Hold Person at 5, Remove Curse at 9, Ice Storm at 13, Cone of Cold at 17.

Fortifying Soul.summary: Magic action: up to WIS modifier creatures you see (min 1) each heal 1d10 + Ranger level and get Advantage on saves against Frightened for 1 hour. Once per Long Rest.

Chilling Retribution.summary: Reaction when a creature's attack roll hits you: it makes a WIS save or is Stunned, with Speed 0, until the end of your next turn. WIS modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Frozen Haunt.summary: When you cast Hunter's Mark, take a ghostly snow form for the spell's duration: Cold immunity, 2d4 Cold to chosen creatures in a 15-ft Emanation as it starts and each turn, and you pass through creatures and objects. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 4+ slot.

options.name: Frozen Soul
options.summary: Immune to Cold. On entering the form and at the start of each later turn, chosen creatures in a 15-ft Emanation take 2d4 Cold.

options.name: Partially Incorporeal
options.summary: Immune to Grappled, Prone and Restrained. Move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force if you end a turn inside one; when the form ends you're pushed to the nearest free space.
